column3: Redesigns the admin: role-based sidebar, mobile bottom bar, command palette, light and dark. Installs as a PWA.
One AI hub for every package: keys, models, spending limits and a shared AI chat.
Cookie-free site analytics that keep visitor data on your site. Sources, donation funnel and journeys.
Sapling and campaign donations on WooCommerce with card, bank transfer and monthly giving. A certificate for every gift.
A WhatsApp inbox with canned replies, tags and assignment. An AI assistant that records donations and certificates.
Makes the site multilingual: /en/ addresses, per-post translations, hreflang and a language switcher.
Drag-and-drop form builder with multi-step forms, payments, conditional logic and automations.
Task tracking with projects, lists, boards and calendars. Meeting reports, notifications and MCP tools.
Brings private themes and plugins from your own update server into the WordPress updates screen.
Every e-mail the site sends, a mailbox and delivery logs in one place. WhatsApp and SMS lines shared with other packages.
Queries, PHP errors, slow requests, server, database and cron on one screen. Home of the System Check.
Staff, Manager and Admin roles; every package's capabilities on one page. Personal referral links.
Meta, Open Graph, schema, sitemap and SEO checks. An MCP server for AI assistants.
Certificate templates, live PDF preview and /certificate/{code} verification. Sent by e-mail, SMS and WhatsApp.
Social media inside the site: accounts, scheduling, approval and calendar. AI writing help and MCP tools.
An AI image and video studio. Generation, references and a foldered gallery through Flux AI.
Sign-in for the desktop and mobile app: OAuth 2.0 (PKCE), API keys and a role-based menu.
Automatic backups before updates, scheduled full backups and selective restore.
A simple, fast WooCommerce block theme. Hero, header, footer and home patterns are fully replaceable by presets.

Qurbani management: collections from collectors and WhatsApp groups, monthly rent and gift tracking for beneficiaries, rule-based distribution with delivery confirmation, Flux AI chat tools and a one-click site preset.
Preset engine: one file sets up the organisation profile, settings, header/footer, templates, pages and menus. Edits the site through approved patches from AI chat and MCP.
